rbld_rules.name: Fail-Closed Exchange & Fundamental Integrity
rbld_rules.description: Blocks routing when spot price, OHLCV bar, or live fundamentals are unavailable or invalid.

rbld_rules.name: Desk Drawdown, Reconciliation & BTCA Circuit Breaker
rbld_rules.description: Halts new BUY routing when drawdown >= 10%, recon drift > INR 0.01, SAFE_MODE active, or BTCA slippage drift > 75 bps.

rbld_rules.name: Live vs EOD Reference Price Band
rbld_rules.description: Blocks routing when live price deviates > 5.0% from EOD reference bar.

rbld_rules.name: 20D ADV Floor & Participation Cap
rbld_rules.description: Requires >= INR 2.0 Cr 20D average daily turnover and <= 1.5% ADV participation per order.

rbld_rules.name: Intraday Spread & Volatility Shield
rbld_rules.description: Blocks entries when H-L spread range > 7.5% or 20D daily vol > 6.0%.

rbld_rules.name: Pre-Trade AIM Single-Stock & Sector Caps
rbld_rules.description: Enforces single-stock <= 15% NAV, sector <= 30% NAV, and max open tactical slots.

rbld_rules.name: Pre-Trade TCA Net-of-Cost EV Hurdle
rbld_rules.description: Requires expected net alpha (bps) minus Pre-Trade TCA costs >= effective EV hurdle.
